title: Online Task, Trading-Group and 'Guaranteed Return' Investment Scams
publisher: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs
text: Task-based scams begin with a WhatsApp or Telegram message offering part-time income for simple tasks such as liking YouTube videos, following social-media pages or rating hotels and products. Victims are paid small amounts at first to build trust, then asked to 'invest' or pre-pay for 'prepaid tasks' or 'VIP levels' with the promise of higher commissions; the dashboard shows growing fake profits, and withdrawals are blocked unless more money, 'tax' or 'fees' is paid. Investment and trading scams invite people into WhatsApp or Telegram groups that share 'stock tips', IPO allotments or crypto signals and ask them to install an unknown trading app or website showing fake gains. Warning signs: guaranteed or very high returns, pressure to invest quickly, apps not available on official app stores, payments to individual UPI IDs or bank accounts rather than a SEBI-registered intermediary, and demands for fees to withdraw. Check whether an investment adviser or broker is registered with SEBI before investing. Stop paying immediately if asked for withdrawal fees, and report at cybercrime.gov.in or helpline 1930.
